hero.eyebrow: Made to order · Handmade in Australia
hero.heading: Softly made,
hero.lead: Custom shirts, hoodies and cushions — sewn one at a time, in the colours and cuts you actually want.

about.heading: Hello, I'm Betty.
about.body:
I've been sewing for as long as I can remember. Bespoke Betty is where I make custom pieces to order — a jumper in the exact grey you've been hunting for, a cushion cut from your grandmother's fabric, a shirt that finally fits.

Every piece is made by hand, one at a time. Tell me what you have in mind and we'll work it out together.

contact.heading: Let's make something.
contact.lead: Send a few details and I'll get back to you within a couple of days.
